discourse.title: God Alone Can Confer Love And Peace
discourse.excerpt: You cannot experience peace in the external world. Wherever you go, you find only unrest and agitation. The peace that you aspire for is very much in you. The divine principle in you is verily the embodiment of peace. Forgetting such reality, you are craving for non-lasting peace in the external world. Stop searching for peace outside. Turn inward and try to experience peace, which is your very form.
discourse.theme: Peace is within you — stop searching outside.

reflection: Why does peace keep slipping away the moment you find it? Because, Swami says, you have been looking for it outside — in people, plans and possessions — while it sits quietly inside you all along. Try His prescription today: stop the outward search for five minutes, turn inward, and simply rest in the peace that is your very form.

video.title: Without this, you cannot find True Peace | Sri Sathya Sai Speaks | Jul 04, 2001

seva_nudge: Give five silent minutes to someone who needs calm — sit with them, no advice, just presence.
